title: WHAT GOD SHOWED ME WOULD HAPPEN IN 2026 ! AAPOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
text: I want you to understand something very clearly tonight. When God begins to open spiritual dimensions to you, [music] when he begins to show you things that are yet to come, it is not for entertainment. The spirit of prophecy, the Bible says, is the testimony of [music] Jesus. Every prophetic revelation is designed to align you, to position you, to prepare you for what God is about to do. And so, as I stand before you this evening, I come not with conningly devised fables. I come not with the wisdom of men, but I come with a word that has been burning in my spirit for weeks. God has been speaking to me about the year 2026. [music] Now, somebody might say, "But we're still in 2025." Yes, but you must understand that in the kingdom of God, preparation precedes manifestation. God shows you things ahead of time so that you can align yourself accordingly. Let me take you to the book of Amos 3:7. The Bible says, "Surely the Lord God does nothing unless he reveals his secret to his servants, the prophets." This is a fundamental principle of the kingdom. God does not [music] operate arbitrarily. Before he moves, before he acts, before he shifts things in the natural, he first reveals it in the spirit to those who have eyes to see and ears to hear. Now, I need you to pay attention because what I'm about to share with you is going to require spiritual sensitivity. It's going to require that you engage your spirit, man. Don't just listen with your physical ears. Listen with your spiritual ears. There are dimensions of understanding that will only come when your spirit is awakened to hear what the spirit is saying. In the last few weeks, as I've been seeking the face of God, as I've been in travailing prayer, as I've been waiting on him, God began to pull back the curtain of time and show me things concerning 2026. And I'm going to share with you what the Lord showed me, not so that you can be passive [music] observers, but so that you can be active participants in what God is about to do. The first thing God showed me about 2026 is this. It is a year of supernatural acceleration. Now, when I use the word acceleration, I'm not talking about the normal progression of time. I'm talking about a dimension where time bows to purpose, where delays are cancelled, where [music] processes that should take years are compressed into months, where divine speed overtakes natural pace. You see, there are seasons in the kingdom where God allows processes to take their natural [music] course. But there are also seasons where God steps into time and accelerates things. And God said to me clearly, 2026 [music] is a year where I will accelerate my purposes in the lives of my people. This means that if you position yourself correctly, if you align yourself with what God is doing, you will experience acceleration in every [music] area of your life. The Bible tells us in Isaiah 60:22, "A little one shall become a thousand and a small one a [music] strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in its time." [music] This word hasten means to accelerate, to speed up, to cause, to come to pass quickly. And God is saying that 2026 is a year where he will hasten his promises in the lives of those who are positioned. But let me tell you something that's very important. Acceleration requires preparation. You cannot be accelerated beyond your capacity. God will not promote you into a dimension that you cannot sustain. And so, even as we're talking about acceleration, understand that the preparation you're undergoing right now, the processes you're going through, the wilderness experiences, the testing, the trials, they are all preparing you for the acceleration that is coming. There are people in this room right now. There are people watching me and you've been in a season of delay. Things that you prayed about, things that you believe God for, they seem like they're taking too long. You've been faithful, you've been consistent, you've been diligent, but it seems like heaven is silent. I came to prophesy to you, your season of delay is coming to an end. 2026 is your year of supernatural acceleration. The second thing God showed me about 2026 is that it is a year of strategic repositioning. Now this is very crucial. You see every season in God has its requirements. There are dimensions of blessing that cannot come to you in your current position. God has to reposition you. He has to shift you. He has to move you from where you are to where you need to be. When I say repositioning, I'm talking about geographical repositioning, relational repositioning, spiritual repositioning, mental repositioning. God is going to begin to orchestrate divine movements. Some of you are going to receive job offers from places you never expected. Some of you are going to meet people who are going to be connectors for you. Some of you are going to be moved by the hand of God from one level to another. The Bible tells us in Genesis 12 when God called Abraham, he said, "Get out of your country, from your family, and from your father's house to a land that I will show you." This was a divine repositioning. Abraham had to leave where he [music] was comfortable to go to where God was calling him. And when he obeyed that instruction, the Bible says, "I will make you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great." God is saying in 2026, I'm going to reposition my people. But you need to understand that repositioning requires obedience. When God tells you to move, you have to move. When God tells you to let go of [music] certain relationships, you have to let go. When God tells you to step out of your comfort zone, you have to step out because the blessing you're looking for is not in [music] your current position. It's in your next position. Some of you have been praying, "God, open doors for me." But God is saying, [music] "I've been trying to move you, but you're holding on to things I told you to release. There are relationships you're supposed to let go of. There are habits you're supposed to break. There are mindsets you're supposed to change. God cannot reposition you until you're willing to let go of what's behind." The third thing God showed me about 2026, and this is very significant, is that it is a year of prophetic fulfillment. God said to me, "Tell my people that words I spoke to them years ago. Promises I made to them that they thought were forgotten. Prophecies that were given that they thought would never come to pass. 2026 is the year of their fulfillment." You see, the challenge with prophetic words is that there's always a gap between the promise and the performance, between the declaration and the manifestation. And in that gap, many people lose faith. They begin to doubt. They begin to question whether God really spoke. But I want you to understand something. God is not a man that he should lie. Numbers 23:19 says, "God is not a man that he should lie, nor a son of man that he should repent. Has he said and will he not do? Or has he spoken and will he [music] not make it good?" Every word that has been spoken over your life by the spirit of God, every prophetic declaration, every promise from scripture that you've held on to, 2026 is going to be a year where you see things begin to come to pass. Things that seemed impossible, things that seemed like they were taking too long, suddenly you're going to see the hand of God move in power. But let me tell you the condition for prophetic fulfillment. You must remain in faith. You must continue to speak the word. You must continue to declare what God has said. Even when your physical eyes don't see it. Even when your circumstances contradict it, you must hold fast to [music] the word of God. Because the Bible says faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen. I'm speaking to somebody right now. And God gave you a promise concerning your marriage. He gave you a promise concerning your children. He [music] gave you a promise concerning your business. He gave you a promise concerning your ministry and you've been holding on to that word, but it's been years and you haven't seen anything. God is saying to you, don't give up now. 2026 [music] is your year of prophetic fulfillment. The fourth thing the Lord showed me about 2026 is that it's going to be a year of heightened spiritual warfare. Now, I need you to understand this because I'm not just going to tell you the pleasant things. If you're going to walk in the fullness of what God has for you in 2026, [music] you need to understand that the enemy is going to intensify his attacks. The Bible makes it very clear that we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this age, against spiritual hosts of wickedness in the heavenly places. And whenever God is about to release acceleration, whenever he's about to reposition his people, whenever prophetic words are about to be fulfilled, the enemy goes [music] on the offensive. But I came to tell you that greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world. The Bible says in Exodus 14:14, "The Lord will fight for you, and you shall hold your peace." You don't need to be afraid of the enemy. You don't need to be intimidated, but you do need to be prepared. You need to be spiritually alert. You need to be watching. You need to be praying. 2026 [music] is going to require militant prayer. is going to require aggressive intercession. Is going to require that you know how to use your spiritual weapons. The Bible talks about the whole armor of God. You're going to need to be fully dressed in your spiritual armor. You're going to need to have the belt of truth, the breastplate of [music] righteousness, your feet short with the preparation of the gospel of peace, the shield of faith, the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the spirit which is the word of God. And let me tell you something about spiritual warfare. It's not optional. If you're going to walk in the prophetic destiny that God has for you, if you're going to experience [music] the acceleration, if you're going to walk in the fulfillment of his promises, you must be prepared to fight. You must be prepared to stand. You must be prepared [music] to resist the devil until he flees from you. The fifth thing God showed me about 2026 [music] is that it's a year of divine connections and relationships. God said, "I'm going to begin to orchestrate meetings. I'm going to begin to bring people together who have been separated. I'm going to begin to connect my people to the right people." You see, one of the greatest [music] blessings in life is divine connection. Your destiny is tied to relationships. There are people God has ordained to be part [music] of your journey. There are people who carry keys to doors that you need to go through. There are people who have the grace that you need. There are people who have the wisdom that you need. There are people who have the resources that [music] you need. And God is saying in 2026, I'm going to orchestrate divine appointments. You're going to meet people that you were not expecting to meet. You're going to connect with individuals who are going to be instrumental in helping you fulfill your purpose. But you need [music] to be spiritually sensitive to recognize these connections when they come. Not every connection is a divine connection. Not every relationship is meant to be permanent. You need to have discernment. You need to be able to distinguish between divine connections and demonic distractions because the enemy will also send people into your life to derail you, to distract you, to pull you off course. The Bible talks about Jonathan and David. It says their souls were knit together. That's a divine connection. When you have a divine connection with someone, your spirits connect. You flow together. You compliment each other. Iron sharpens iron. But when you have the wrong connection, they drain you. They distract you. They pull you away from what God has called you to do. So in 2026, ask God for discernment concerning relationships. Ask him to reveal to you who should be in your life and who should not be in your life. Ask him to bring the right people and remove the wrong people because your next level is connected to the right relationships. The sixth thing the Lord showed me about 2026, and this is powerful, is that is a year of uncommon grace. Now, when I talk about uncommon grace, I'm talking about a dimension of grace that is beyond the ordinary. I'm talking about grace that causes you to excel beyond your [music] natural ability. I'm talking about grace that opens doors that no man can shut. The Bible tells us in 2 Corinthians 9:8, "And God is able to make all grace abound [music] toward you, that you always having all sufficiency in all things, may have an abundance for every good work." This is talking about a dimension where grace becomes super abundant, where you have more than enough, where you're [music] not struggling, where you're not striving, where the favor of God just rests upon your life. God said to me concerning 2026, I'm going to release uncommon grace upon my people. This means people are going to look at you and wonder how you achieving what you achieving. They're going to see you excel in ways that don't [music] make sense naturally. They're going to see doors open for you that they know you didn't open yourself. This is what happened to Joseph. The Bible says the Lord was with Joseph and he was a prosperous [music] man. Everywhere Joseph went, he prospered. In Portifer's house, he prospered. In prison, he prospered. And eventually, he ended up in Pharaoh's palace. That's uncommon grace. That's the kind of grace where it doesn't matter what environment you're in, the blessing of God follows you. [music] Some of you have been working hard. You've been putting in effort. You've been doing everything you know to do, but things are still difficult. God is saying in 2026, I'm going to [music] release uncommon grace. Things that were difficult are going to become easy. Things that seemed impossible are going to become possible. You're going to walk in a dimension of favor that you've never experienced before. The seventh thing God showed me about 2026 is that it's a year of revelation and understanding. God said, "I'm going to open the eyes of understanding of my people. I'm going to cause them to see things they've never seen before. I'm going to give them insight and wisdom that will set them apart." The Bible tells us in Daniel 12:4, "But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book until the time of the end. Many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase." We're living in a time where God is releasing revelatory knowledge to his people. He's opening up mysteries. He's unveiling secrets. In 2026, God is going to give you understanding that will give you advantage. He's going to show you things about your business that will cause you to excel. He's going to show you things about your ministry that will cause you to be more effective. He's going to give you spiritual insight that will help you navigate the times. But revelation requires hunger. You cannot be passive and expect God to download revelation to you. You have to seek him. You have to press in. You have to create time to wait on him. The Bible says those who [music] wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. When you wait on God, when you linger in his presence, he begins to open things up to you. The eighth dimension God showed me about 2026 is that it's a year of financial breakthrough and [music] wealth transfer. Now, I want you to understand something. God is not against prosperity. God is not against his people being wealthy. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 8:18, "And you shall remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you power [music] to get wealth." God showed me that in 2026, there's going to be an unusual release of financial blessing upon the lives of believers. But this is not going to come through lottery. This is not going to come through shortcuts. This is going to come through divine ideas, through business concepts, through innovations, through favor, through open doors. God is going to give people ideas that will generate wealth. He's going to open doors of opportunity that will bring financial increase. He's [music] going to cause businesses to flourish. He's going to cause investments to yield returns. But you must be a good steward. You must understand that the wealth is not just for you is for the advancement of the kingdom. The Bible talks about the wealth of the sinner being stored up for the righteous. There's going to be a transfer of wealth [music] in 2026. Resources are going to flow from the kingdom of darkness into the kingdom [music] of light. But you must be positioned. You must be prepared. You must have the right mindset. The ninth thing God showed me about 2026 is that it's a year of healing and restoration. God said, "I'm going to heal bodies. I'm going to heal minds. I'm going to heal emotions. I'm going to restore [music] what has been broken." Some of you have been dealing with chronic sickness. Some of you have been dealing with emotional trauma. Some of you have been dealing with broken relationships. God is saying 2026 is your year of healing and restoration. The Bible tells us in Joel 2:25, "So I will restore to you the years that the swaming locust has eaten." God is a God of restoration. He doesn't just heal, he restores. He doesn't just fix what's broken, he makes it better than it was before. I'm speaking to somebody right now and you've lost things. You've lost relationships. You've lost opportunities. You've lost finances. God is saying what you lost in previous seasons, I'm going to restore to [music] you in 2026. Not only am I going to restore what you lost, I'm going to give you double for your trouble. Now, let me move into prayer because everything I've shared with you needs to be activated through prayer. You cannot just hear prophetic [music] words and be passive. You must pray. You must decree. You must declare, you must engage in militant [music] intercession. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I thank you for this word you've [music] given us concerning 2026. I thank you that even now as we stand in the latter part of 2025, you're preparing us, you're positioning us, you're aligning us with your purposes. Lord, I decree supernatural acceleration over every person hearing my voice right now. Every delay is canceled in the name of Jesus. Every setback is reversed in the [music] name of Jesus. I prophesy speed. I prophesy acceleration. I prophesy divine momentum into your life right now. Things that have been stagnant shall begin to move. Things that have been dormant shall come alive. Things that seem dead shall resurrect by the power of the Holy Spirit. Lord, concerning strategic repositioning, I pray that you would move your people by your spirit. Wherever you want them to be, cause them to go there. Whatever you want them to release, give them the grace to let it go. Whatever doors you want to open, open them. Whatever connections you want to make, orchestrate them in Jesus name. Father, I pray concerning prophetic fulfillment. Every word that has been spoken, every promise that has been made, every prophetic declaration that has gone forth, I decree that 2026 shall be the year of manifestation. What you have spoken shall come to pass. What you have promised shall be fulfilled. Let every word find its fulfillment in Jesus's mighty name. Now, concerning spiritual warfare, I decree that every child of God shall be equipped for battle. Lord, teach their hands to war and their fingers to fight. Clothe them with the whole armor of God. Let the shield of faith be strong. Let the sword of the spirit be sharp. Let them walk in supernatural protection, supernatural covering, supernatural defense against every attack of the enemy. I bind every spirit of python that's trying to squeeze the life out of God's people. I bind every spirit of delay. I bind every spirit [music] of confusion. I bind every spirit of discouragement. I lose the spirit of faith. I lose the spirit of hope. I lose the spirit of joy. I lose the spirit of victory in Jesus name. Father, concerning divine connections, I pray that you would orchestrate strategic [music] meetings. Bring your people to the right people at the right time. Let them connect with those who will help them fulfill their destiny and disconnect them [music] from every wrong relationship, every toxic connection, every demonic association. Let iron sharpen [music] iron in Jesus' name. Lord, release uncommon grace. Let your favor rest upon your people like a cloud. Let them walk in supernatural increase. Let them experience breakthrough in every area of their lives. Financially, spiritually, relationally, mentally, physically. Let them prosper and be in health even as their soul [music] prospers. Father, open the eyes of understanding. Release revelation knowledge. Give your people insight and wisdom. Show them things to come. Reveal mysteries to them. Let them walk in prophetic clarity concerning their lives and their destinies. Remove every veil. Remove every blindness. Remove every limitation from their spiritual sight. And Lord, release financial breakthrough. Open the windows of heaven and pour out blessings that there shall not be room enough to receive. Give divine ideas. Open doors of opportunity. Let businesses flourish. Let investments prosper. And let there be a transfer of wealth from the kingdom of darkness into the kingdom of light. Finally, Father, I decree healing and restoration. Touch every sick body right now. Touch every broken heart right now. Touch every wounded soul right now. Restore what has been broken. Heal what has been damaged. Resurrect what has died. Let your healing power flow like a river into the lives of your people. I speak to chronic diseases be healed in Jesus' name. I speak to emotional trauma be healed in Jesus' name. I speak to broken relationships be restored in Jesus' name. I speak to mental torment be delivered in Jesus' name. Let the power of God that raised Jesus from the dead quicken these mortal bodies. Let your resurrection life flow through every fiber of their being. Now I want you to begin to pray aggressively. Begin to decree what God has spoken. Begin to declare what you've heard. Don't just receive this word passively. [music] Engage with it. Fight for it. Contend for it. Open your mouth and begin to prophesy over your own life. Say, 2026 [music] is my year of supernatural acceleration. Every delay in my life is canceled. Every setback is reversed. I'm moving forward with divine speed. I'm experiencing God's acceleration in every area of my life. Say 2026 is my year of strategic repositioning. God is moving me to where I need to be. [music] He's connecting me with the right people. He's opening the right doors. He's closing the wrong doors. I'm being positioned for my next level. Say, 2026 [music] is my year of prophetic fulfillment. Every word that God has spoken over my life shall come to pass. Every promise shall be fulfilled. Every prophecy shall manifest. What God has said concerning me shall surely come to pass. Keep declaring. Keep decreeing. Keep speaking because there's power in your words. The Bible says death and life are in the power of the tongue. You have [music] the ability to speak things into existence. You have the authority to decree a thing and it shall be established. Somebody shout, I receive this word. I believe this word. I act on this word. 2026 is my year of unprecedented blessing, uncommon favor and supernatural breakthrough. May the Lord establish his word in your life. May everything I've spoken come to pass in Jesus's mighty name. You are blessed and highly favored. You are victorious. You are an overcomer. And 2026 is going to be your best year yet. Now lift your hands and begin to thank God. Thank him for what he's about to do. Thank him for the acceleration. Thank him for the positioning. Thank him for the fulfillment.
